notes: Source is Behringer's official WING Quick Start Guide (Music Tribe), Specifications section pp.61-62, cross-checked against the rear-panel diagram on p.12 and behringer.com product page. Desktop/tabletop control surface (not rack-mountable), so rackUnits omitted. AES50 ports use etherCON (RJ45-compatible locking connector) at 100 Mbit/s per port - Klark Teknik SuperMAC protocol; grade omitted because AES50/SuperMAC bandwidth is not on the RJ45 Ethernet grade scale (eth-100m/1g/etc. refer to standard Ethernet networking, not the proprietary 48-channel audio protocol carried over AES50). The 2 rear LAN/control Ethernet ports are 1 Gbit/s per spec (eth-1g). USB-B device port carries 48x48 channel audio at 24-bit (no defined USB speed grade given beyond USB 2.0, so usb-2.0 used per spec sheet's explicit "USB 2.0 type B/A" wording). GPIO is 2x2 on 1/4" TRS jacks (logic I/O, not audio - no connector-appropriate grade). MIDI is standard 5-pin DIN. StageCONNECT master I/O is a single bidirectional XLR3 carrying up to 32 channels + 12V/18W phantom-style power to a connected stagebox; modeled as bidirectional XLR3. Digital AES/EBU stereo I/O uses XLR connectors (1 in, 1 out). Aux I/O spec states "8 in / 6 out + 2 monitor/phones outs" on 1/4" TRS balanced mono jacks - modeled as 8 discrete AUX IN, 6 discrete AUX OUT, plus 2 dedicated Monitor Out jacks (also TRS). Separate stereo Phones outputs (2x 1/4" TRS) also present. Expansion card slot (rear cage accepting WING-LIVE SD recorder card, or optional Dante/AES67/SoundGrid/MADI cards) is a physical card-edge interface, not a standard connector type in the given list, so it was omitted from ports since it has no fixed connector id; the pre-installed WING-LIVE card's dual SD slots are also non-standard connectors and omitted. Power: IEC mains inlet with switch, 100-240VAC auto-ranging.
